POV: “I’ll eat healthy tomorrow” starts right after this bite 😭  Creamy Cheesy Buldak Noodles 🌶️🧀 Ingredients 2 slices American cheese 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 2 tbsp ketchup 2 tbsp Kewpie mayo 1 tbsp chili oil (plus more for topping) 1 packet Buldak sauce and seasoning powder 2–3 tbsp chopped green onions (plus more for garnish) ½ cup heavy cream 1 packet Buldak noodles, boiled until half cooked Cooked dumplings, for topping Cooked sausage, sliced, for topping Instructions In a pan over low heat, add the American cheese and baby Swiss cheese. Add the ketchup, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, seasoning powder, and chopped green onions. Stir until the cheese melts and everything is well combined. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Add the half-cooked Buldak noodles and toss until every strand is coated in the rich, cheesy sauce. Top with cooked dumplings and sliced sausage. Finish with an extra drizzle of chili oil and more chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy! #r#ramenb#buldakr#Recipec#cookspicy

Hangover🫠? A spoonful of chili oil and seafood make everything hotter and better.🔥 Shrimp heads, soft tofu, crab, octopus, and juicy shrimp simmer into a rich, spicy broth that’s guaranteed to bring you back to life❤️‍🔥 Would you try this after a night out?🍜✨ 📍 Tag your late-night buddy & save this recipe for your next rough morning ✨ Hailey’s Hangover Seafood Tofu Ramen 📝 Ingredients * 2–3 tbsp chili oil * 2 eggs * 1 green onion, chopped * 2–3 cloves garlic, sliced * 1 pack Shin Ramyun (soup base + veggie packet) * 2 cups water * 3–5 large shrimp (heads separated) * 1 small crab * Baby octopus * Soft tofu * Rice cakes * A handful of bok choy (or bean sprouts) * Fresh red chili, sliced 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Heat the chili oil over medium heat. Crack in one egg and let the edges crisp slightly. 2. Add the shrimp heads, crab, baby octopus, garlic, and green onion. Sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. 3. Remove the egg and octopus so they don’t overcook. 4. Stir in the Shin Ramyun soup base and veggie packet, then pour in the water. Bring to a boil. 5. Add the noodles, soft tofu, rice cakes, and shrimp. Cover and cook for about 2 minutes. 6. Return the octopus and add the bok choy. Cook just until the shrimp turn pink and the bok choy is tender-crisp. 7. Top with the crispy egg, an extra egg yolk (optional), and fresh red chili. Enjoy immediately. 💡 Tip: Add a splash of soy sauce if the broth needs a little more seasoning.  #asmrfood #mukbang #ramenhacks #hangovercure #fyp

alt makeup!!! #alt #makeup #altmakeup #xoxo  Ryuk is a Shinigami (God of Death) from the world of the Shinigami in the series Death Note. Unlike most Shinigami, who spend their time quietly extending their own lifespans by taking human lives, Ryuk becomes incredibly bored with his existence. Seeking entertainment, he intentionally drops a Death Note—a supernatural notebook that can kill anyone whose name is written in it—into the human world. The notebook is found by Light Yagami, a brilliant high school student. Ryuk then follows Light and watches as he begins using the Death Note to kill criminals and create a world free of crime. Throughout the story, Ryuk acts more like an observer than a participant. He does not help Light achieve his goals, nor does he actively try to stop him. Instead, he watches the events unfold because he finds them entertaining. Ryuk is known for his frightening appearance, dark sense of humor, and obsession with apples, which he considers a rare treat from the human world. Although he often laughs at human behavior and enjoys chaos, he is generally honest about his intentions and never pretends to be something he isn't. One of Ryuk's defining characteristics is his neutrality. He repeatedly reminds Light that he is not his friend and that he is simply watching the story for his own amusement. In fact, Ryuk tells Light from the beginning that when the time comes, he will be the one to write Light's name in the Death Note. At his core, Ryuk serves as the catalyst for the entire story. Without him dropping the Death Note into the human world, the events of Death Note would never have happened. He represents curiosity, boredom, and the unpredictable consequences that can occur when immense power is placed in human hands.

A standout shoyu ramen spot in Tokyo. Their signature menu is the “Special Shoyu Ramen.” Built on a chicken-based broth blended with multiple soy sauces, the first sip brings out the richness of chicken oil, deep umami from the soy sauce, and a subtle sweetness. As you continue, the flavors finish clean and balanced. The charcoal-grilled chashu adds a gentle smoky aroma that naturally melts into the broth✨ The straight noodles hold the soup well, delivering its flavor all the way through each bite. The chashu comes in a variety of cuts, each prepared differently—from rich, fatty pieces to lighter, more delicate textures—letting you enjoy a contrast of juiciness and mouthfeel. [Ramen Sakurai 麺屋 さくら井] - Location: 2 Chome-15-27 Kamirenjaku, Mitaka, Tokyo, Japan - Hours: Mon & Sat 11:30 - 15:00 / 18:00 - 20:30, Tue/Thu/Fri 11:30 - 15:00, Sun 11:30 - 16:00 (Closed Wed) - Menu: Special Shoyu Ramen (¥2,000) #ramen #tokyoramen #shoyuramen #라멘

Creamy Cheesy Buldak Ramen 🍜🧀🔥 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 1 slice American cheese 1 slice Monterey Jack cheese 2 tbsp mayo Buldak sauce packet Buldak powder packet Chili oil 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp chopped green onions ½ cup heavy cream or milk Cooked ramen noodles Toppings Fried egg Mini sausages Dumplings Extra green onions Extra chili oil Instructions Cook the Buldak noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. In a pan over low heat, add the baby Swiss, American, and Monterey Jack cheese slices. Add the mayo, Buldak sauce, Buldak powder, chili oil, minced garlic, and green onions on top of the cheese. Mix everything together until the cheese melts into a thick spicy paste. Pour in the heavy cream or milk and stir until smooth and creamy. Add the cooked noodles and toss until fully coated in the sauce. Top with fried egg, dumplings, mini sausages, extra green onions, and more chili oil if desired. Enjoy hot and creamy  #buldak #buldakramen #eat #food  #Foodie

컨테이너 밑에서 벌벌 떨며 살아가던 이름 없는 야외 마당 강아지. 1차 환경개선 이후에도 눈 상태가 계속 마음에 걸려 견주분을 설득한 끝에 병원 진료를 허락받을 수 있었습니다. 겁이 많은 아이는 안전하게 이동장에 태운 뒤 병원으로 이동하였고, 마침 쉬는 날이었음에도 감사하게도 수의사님께서 직접 진료를 봐주셨습니다. 아이의 체중은 약 3.5kg, 나이는 1~2살 정도로 추정되는 여자아이였습니다. 가장 먼저 걱정했던 눈 상태를 확인한 결과 다행히 심각한 질환은 아니었고 습진으로 인한 증상이라는 진단을 받았습니다. 안약을 처방받아 꾸준히 관리하면 충분히 좋아질 수 있다고 하셨습니다. 이후 심장사상충 검사를 위해 채혈을 진행했고, 안타깝게도 아이에게 심장사상충이 확인되었습니다. 심장사상충은 꾸준한 치료와 관리가 필요한 질환으로 앞으로 한 달 이상 치료를 받아야 하는 상황이었습니다. 진료를 마친 뒤 견주분께 현재 상태를 자세히 설명드렸지만 견주분께서는 혼자 생활하고 계셔 지속적인 치료와 관리를 이어가기 어려운 상황이었고, 야외 생활을 하는 환경에서는 사실상 치료를 진행하기 쉽지 않은 상황이었습니다. 하지만 아이는 밥도 정말 잘 먹고, 어려운 환경 속에서도 묵묵히 하루하루를 버텨내고 있었습니다. 현재 아이는 심장사상충 치료와 함께 새로운 가족을 찾고 있습니다. 겁이 많지만 순하고 착한 아이이며, 이제는 더 이상 컨테이너 밑이 아닌 따뜻한 집에서 사랑받으며 살아갈 수 있었으면 좋겠습니다. 🐾 이 아이와 평생을 함께해 주실 가족을 찾고 있습니다. 📩 문의 : rltjddlrk12@gmail.com 아이가 건강을 회복하고 행복한 가족을 만날 수 있도록 많은 관심과 응원 부탁드립니다. ❤️ 🐾 햅독의 작은 부탁이 있습니다. 평소 쿠팡에서 구매할 물건이 있으셨다면 상단 프로필 링크를 통해 접속 후 24시간 내 아무 상품이나 구매해 주세요. 여러분의 구매로 발생한 수수료는 쿠팡으로부터 햅독에 지급되며, 이렇게 모인 수수료는 시골 강아지들의 사료와 간식, 더 나은 환경을 만들어주는 데 사용됩니다. 여러분의 작은 관심이 아이들에게는 큰 행복이 됩니다. 오늘도 함께해 주셔서 진심으로 감사합니다. 🧡
